$comment: The machine-readable mirror of the Commands table in CLAUDE.md.
repo:check derives the count from parsing that table — never from a literal here.
kind        root-script | filtered-script | bin — decides how the entry is resolved.
subject     the path whose existence defines `implemented`. Asserted.
blockedBy   documentation for the stub message. NEVER asserted: conflating it with
subject fires a false red the moment the blocking file lands.
ci          pr | none. `dev` is persistent, so it is `none` or the matrix hangs.

dev.subject: turbo.json
dev.$comment: persistent task — never in the CI matrix, never spawned by the contract test

check.subject: scripts/check.ts
check.gate: The one command a contributor runs before pushing. Derived from this file.
check.$comment: ci:none deliberately — CI runs the matrix in PARALLEL. Running check as a job would re-run every other job serially inside one runner and roughly triple the wall clock for no extra coverage.

test:contract.subject: tooling/vitest/replay-transport.ts
test:contract.gate: Layer 2 replays recorded provider bytes. No fixtures exist yet.

test:e2e.subject: apps/gateway/src/app.e2e.test.ts
test:e2e.gate: Boots the real Hono app against testcontainers Postgres and Valkey.

test:live.subject: packages/adapters/src/canary.live.test.ts
test:live.gate: Scheduled, never PR-blocking. Needs real provider keys, so it cannot run on a fork PR.

conformance.subject: packages/adapters/conformance/index.ts
conformance.gate: One shared suite, parameterized by adapter. Half of Phase 1's definition of done.

new-adapter.subject: scripts/new-adapter.ts
new-adapter.$comment: requires <id>; the matrix runs commands bare, so ci must be none. Verified by test/commands/new-adapter.unit.test.ts instead.

record.subject: scripts/record.ts
record.gate: Recording needs a provider trial key. Run --dry-run first: credits do not refund, and ScrapingBee's 1,000 never refresh.

selfhost:smoke.subject: scripts/selfhost-smoke.ts
selfhost:smoke.gate: Clean context, docker compose up, health, one replayed request, under five minutes. compose.dev.yml is the dev stack; the full self-host compose does not exist yet.

content:lint.subject: scripts/content-lint.ts
content:lint.gate: Zero MDX pages. A check with nothing to check is not a pass.

test:ssrf.subject: packages/shared/src/edge-guard.ssrf.test.ts
test:ssrf.gate: security-engineer has no write tools and cannot implement its own exit criterion. platform-engineer writes the validator; the vector table is security-engineer's review artifact.

release:dry.subject: scripts/release-dry.ts
release:dry.gate: changeset status clean, npm publish --dry-run per publishable package, image builds.

proxlane doctor.subject: packages/cli/src/doctor.ts
proxlane doctor.gate: The self-host support surface. --version and --help work; doctor exits 1 until it has checks to run.
proxlane doctor.$comment: the only kind:bin entry — resolved via the root workspace dependency on `proxlane`, which links its bin into node_modules/.bin
